scenes.text: Imagine you're a soldier lying on a freezing battlefield in eighteen sixty-two, severely wounded and waiting for help.
As night falls, you look down and realize your wounds are glowing with a strange, bright blue light.
Decades later, researchers discovered the glow was caused by a bioluminescent bacterium that produces natural antibiotics to kill infections.
Would you have panicked if your wounds started glowing, or would you have welcomed the miracle?
